title: Replace plan conditionals with an extensible plan registry
difficulty_rationale: Design-level refactoring: three branching functions must be replaced by a polymorphic Plan hierarchy with a registry, keeping behaviour identical and making new plans addable without editing existing functions.
summary: monthly_price(), seat_limit() and can_upgrade() branch on plan names with long if/elif chains; replace them with Plan classes registered in a registry.
required_behavior: A base class Plan with attributes name, rank and methods monthly_price(seats, annual) and seat_limit().
Concrete plans free, team, business, enterprise registered via register_plan(); get_plan(name) returns the instance and raises UnknownPlanError (KeyError subclass) for unknown names.
The public functions monthly_price, seat_limit and can_upgrade keep their signatures and results and contain no if/elif comparisons on plan names.
A new Plan subclass registered with register_plan() works with all three public functions without modifying them.
No function in billing/plans.py has more than 3 branch nodes (if/elif/ternary/match cases).

acceptance_tests.description: Prices for every plan/seat/annual combination are unchanged.
A new registered Plan subclass works without code changes.
Each function has at most 3 branch nodes and no string comparisons on plan names.
